scientific_integrity: The all-length proof establishes the coefficient law and limit independently of finite verification; known general bond theorem is explicitly credited. Same-model review only; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to uniform layered permutations and exactly one rank-standardized deletion. It does not determine optimal code cardinalities or extend to multiple deletions. Equivalent unindexed work is possible.
title: Exact one-deletion sphere spectrum and Gaussian law for layered permutations
